items.title: Morning Bid: Nvidious
items.summary: Nov 12 (Reuters) - Just when tech stocks looked to be finding their feet again, chip behemoth Nvidia plunged almost 10% overnight on reports its board may now oust troubled CEO Jensen Huang. The board met late on Wednesday and although there has ‌been no formal announcement yet, the Wall Street Journal reported it was about to remove him.
